scope: Internal six-calendar-month retention purge admission using current signed Apple subscription statuses, renewal cancellation before durable first-action grant, resumable deletion and settlement after that grant. No production scheduler.

priorAttempt.result: 80 passed, 2 failed; synthetic upload fixture lacked an active login-account row required by public reads. Added fixture identity and reran targeted and full related race suites.

boundaries: Apple proof is private, environment/revision/deadline bound, and expires 30 seconds after verification starts. All known purchase chains must verify; failure, unknown owned chain or concurrent revision change fails closed.

Renewal and first-action grant serialize on the account lock. A grant commit marks the asset purging and publishes a final visibility tombstone before COS mutation. That durable intent cannot be undone by a subsequent renewal.
SQL commit and a COS HTTP operation are not a distributed atomic transaction; grant does not prove the request was sent or object removed. Interrupted grants resume exact persisted actions.
Public purged change means cloud backup is permanently unavailable to the app; objects_removed and completed remain separate internal observations.
No provider mutation is needed for entirely empty inventories, so settlement must still hold current unexpired authority. Renewal never erases completed settlement receipts.
